值得閱讀的理由

  • 深入剖析《影之刃零》跳脫傳統魂系框架的武俠戰鬥系統，以及高達數十種完全無換皮的特色武器機制。
  • 提供高難度連招下的實戰應對技巧，包含借鑒格鬥遊戲的視線聚焦法與副武器切換循環。
  • 客觀評價遊戲在中式恐怖視聽風格、存檔關卡機制、劇情敘事缺點及各大硬體平台上的優化表現。

摘要

獨樹一幟的武俠動作與武器深度

作者為玩家詳細介紹了備受矚目的國產動作遊戲《影之刃零》。本作的戰鬥系統跳脫了魂系或隻狼的傳統框架，以純正的武俠對決與極具視覺張力的處決動畫為核心。遊戲內建 30 種主武器與 25 種特殊武器，且全數具備獨立的攻擊模組與專屬機制，例如能蓄力展開遠程飛劍攻擊的流光劍或具備強大出血效果的巨劍。此外，遊戲提供全額退還升級素材的重置機制與屬性相剋設定，極力鼓勵玩家針對不同敵人靈活更換配裝。

高節奏戰鬥機制與實用攻防思維

在戰鬥操作上，作者強調不可盲目套用傳統魂系思維，因為敵人的高頻連招極為迅猛。遊戲中持續防禦會消耗殺意值，而殺意值必須依賴切換武器來回復，這要求玩家必須同時熟練掌握兩種武器的輪替節奏。面對高危險技能，作者分享了格鬥遊戲的拆招觀念，建議玩家將視角聚焦於對手動作本體並優化握持手勢以縮短反應時間；在面對強敵時，採取「穩健格擋積攢氣勢、伺機爆發輸出」的穩健打法是相當有效的克敵策略。

陰暗詭譎的視聽氛圍與大膽的關卡變革

在視聽表現方面，作者給予極高評價，特別是遊戲巧妙融合了中式恐怖與傳統武俠風格。諸如頭目青娘阿花登場時的置中對稱構圖，搭配揉合婚慶樂曲、嬰兒啼哭與瘋癲笑聲的配樂，帶來極具壓迫感的沉浸體驗。關卡設計上，本作採用了敵人不重生以及 Boss 第二階段死亡後自動存檔的大膽機制，雖然大幅減少了挫折感，但也意味著無法反覆刷取強化素材；整體主線長度約為 20 至 25 小時。

敘事節奏瑕疵與亮眼的跨平台優化表現

針對不足之處，作者指出遊戲採用碎片化敘事且節奏偏慢，加上場景中存在不少僅有單純站樁反應的 NPC，削弱了故事代入感。但在硬體效能方面，本作展現出令人驚豔的優化水準：PC 端無論是入門級顯卡還是高階旗艦卡皆能穩定流暢運行；而在 PS5 與 PS5 Pro 主機上，遊戲皆提供穩定的多檔幀率模式供玩家挑選，整體技術表現相當扎實成熟。

And there’s my favorite, the Flowing Sword. Normally, it’s just a standard short sword, but it has a unique " drinking" system. Once fully charged, it transforms into a flying sword, allowing for long-range light and heavy attacks. Even the executions are...plus, when a boss has a punishing mechanic, I can just spam the flying sword from afar—it really makes the combat feel like a rhythm game. There are also giant hammers, iron fans, dual rings, and more . Looking forward to new weapons was a huge motivation for me to keep playing.

The special weapons, or "Phantom Gear," can also help you seize the rhythm in battle. For example, this shield can block any attack and counter with full energy, and I also love the charged heavy axe—if you double the stamina cost , you can release a fully charged strike instantly. That charged-up power is just insane. With so many resources poured into these. weapons, what happens if players just stick to one from start to finish? You start the game, hit +10 in the mid-game , +20 in the late-game, and spend 50 hours with one weapon—you guys know what I’m talking about, right? To encourage you to try different weapons, Phantom Blade offers a full refund of upgrade materials when you reset them. There’s no need to stress over which one to upgrade; just try them all out! If you are still struggling with this, even the upgrade materials for different weapons are completely different. After defeating a boss and getting a new weapon, the materials it requires have nothing to do with those needed for your old gear, so you don't have to worry about whether to upgrade the new one or. the old one. Even if you are the type of player who is super reliant on a single playstyle and refuses to switch, * Shadow Person*features a weapon effectiveness system. Some heavy weapons have high guard-break values, which are perfect for slow enemies. Online, you can already find all sorts of builds: life-steal swords, defense bonuses at high health, or even recovering health when your guard is broken—it's like you're reversing the boss fight entirely . That’s why in*Shadow Person*, I really want to upgrade every weapon to try them out; you never know what kind of surprise you might find. But if you jump into the combat blindly using the mindset from other Soulslike games, you’re going to get crushed. *Shadow Person*does have basic left-click blocking and right-click.

dodging, but most boss attacks aren't simple, telegraphed moves you can just dodge; they are very high-speed combos. In this boss fight, we. can hold down or spam the left mouse button to attack while blocking, and even during an attack animation, we can still hold the block button to automatically defend. However, blocking drains your killing intent gauge, which can only be restored by switching weapons, which is why you must know how to use at least two weapons. To keep players from mindlessly defending, bosses have specific skills that must be countered with a perfect block or a perfect dodge. Here, I’ll teach you a technique to improve your reaction time : in fighting games, there’s a move called "counter," where 25 frames after the opponent attacks, you press a button. to knock them down. So, how did those masters of fighting games teach me how to counter? First, you need to change your perspective. Most people play games while looking at the entire space, so your attention is actually quite scattered. However, when you need to focus on your opponent's moves, you should fix your eyes on them and have your gaze follow that person's movements the whole time. This is very useful, and it can speed you up by about 20 to 40 milliseconds. The second point is also very important: you need to keep a finger on this button at all times. As for me, I used to hold the controller like this. With my grip, it’s a bit slow. to move my finger over, so this adjustment can make you another 20 milliseconds faster. If you find yourself pressing the red or blue buttons incorrectly, some people online suggest mapping them to the same key— just mindlessly press it, no matter which one comes out. Let’s just say, as you get further into the game, you'll realize the most effective strategy is actually playing like a turtle. I just parry in place, wait for my spirit to build up, then go in to attack. Once it depletes, I go back to turtling. If I manage a perfect dodge, I go in for a combo. The boss’s HP just determines how many rounds we go. Another point: before you break the opponent's guard, it’s.

easy to end up in a situation where you’re just doing your thing and they’re doing theirs. That’s why some players feel the combat lacks impact or interaction with the enemies. Actually, by the mid-game, their aggression increases significantly, which improves things a lot. They’ll hit you until you’re afraid to move, so you won’t have to worry about a lack of interaction anymore. The art and music in this game are also top-tier. Many boss entrances and battles left a deep impression on me, like the centered, symmetrical composition during the Qingniang Ah Hua sequence, where she raises her hand to lead into the work, surrounded by countless male corpses in the scene. This composition and this setting are pure horror. In the soundtrack collection, there’s a piece for Ah Hua that is actually an old wedding march. I. Never in my wildest dreams would I. have thought to blend these two styles together. However, I noticed it didn’t make it into the final game—perhaps they were worried about the risks of mixing marriage and horror elements. But another track definitely made it into the game. Don't even get me started, this is way too intense. Plus, this music itself contains the sound of a baby crying and the laughter of a demented person. You can even fight Ip Man in the first chapter. >> I want to publicly challenge Ip Man. >> This vibe is just too authentic!

You can switch difficulty settings at any time; honestly, I prefer games with a fixed difficulty, but adjustable difficulty definitely helps sales. High-difficulty enemies. If it were a fixed difficulty, I feel the developers would have set it between normal and hard. The design of the checkpoints is also quite bold; in a game everyone thinks is a Souls-like, enemies don't respawn, and losing to a boss in the second phase actually saves your progress, which also means you can't go back to farm materials. Trying to fully upgrade all gear in a single playthrough is definitely impossible. As for the story, thinking back, I realized there wasn't anything particularly impressive, perhaps because the pacing is just too slow. Actually, I am curious about how the story unfolds, but I personally dislike reading fragmented lore in collectibles; I. prefer the direct narrative style of Black Myth. If you ask me, the only reason people bother with that narrative style is because Elden Ring is just so fun—does anyone really enjoy reading lore in item descriptions? Silly, it’s truly silly. Also, I have to complain: there are way too many NPCs who just stand around; after playing through these three chapters, at least ten people have just stared at me. The optimization this time is a pleasant surprise; I tested it on three machines : an entry-level sweet spot card, a mid-to-high-end build, and a premium 5090. The 4060 holds steady at around 60. FPS at 4K on default settings and about 50 FPS on ultra, with a great experience at 2K resolution. The 5090 at maxed 4K settings, without frame gen or ray tracing, hits around 94 FPS. What do you think of this performance? Whether on PS5 or PS5 Pro, there are three modes corresponding to 60, 45, and 30 frames. If I had to say, the PS5 Pro is more stable with fewer frame rate fluctuations. The only difference is that the PS5 Pro has an extra ray tracing option, which doesn't affect the frame rate.

I'll play them side-by-side; can you guys tell which one has ray tracing enabled? Given this situation, I actually highly recommend that those of you watching use a DualSense controller connected to your PC. I’ve tested it for you, and there is basically no difference in the experience between playing on console or PC. It’s definitely worth trying. Is*Phantom Blade*worth buying? I think it is absolutely worth it. I’m fully sold on the gameplay; I really love the combat and weapon mechanics. At the end of the day, a game being fun is what matters most. To be honest, before I first saw* Phantom Blade*, I had never even heard of the*Phantom Blade*mobile games. I only learned later that back in 2008,. when Liang Qiwei was still a student, he created*Rainblood*. But single-player games didn't make money back then, so they had to rely on mobile games to support the team, leaving his dream martial arts project tucked away in a drawer. In 2020, *Phantom Blade: Executioners*launched. "A single spark can start a prairie fire," and Liang finally had the confidence to take out the shelved project—or in his words, to "dust it off" and start development again, leading to the versions we know and its release today. A martial arts dream spanning nearly 20 years, a new flame ignited by a single. spark. I am. I'm S-Game's Liang Qiwei, the producer of*Phantom Blade Zero*. Thank you all for playing our game. >> Alright, that's all for this video. If you found it interesting, please remember to like and follow—it’s very important for the channel. I'm Qianli, No, noinoi.

  • 提供高難度連招下的實戰應對技巧，包含借鑒格鬥遊戲的視線聚焦法與副武器切換循環。
  • 客觀評價遊戲在中式恐怖視聽風格、存檔關卡機制、劇情敘事缺點及各大硬體平台上的優化表現。

摘要

獨樹一幟的武俠動作與武器深度

作者為玩家詳細介紹了備受矚目的國產動作遊戲《影之刃零》。本作的戰鬥系統跳脫了魂系或隻狼的傳統框架，以純正的武俠對決與極具視覺張力的處決動畫為核心。遊戲內建 30 種主武器與 25 種特殊武器，且全數具備獨立的攻擊模組與專屬機制，例如能蓄力展開遠程飛劍攻擊的流光劍或具備強大出血效果的巨劍。此外，遊戲提供全額退還升級素材的重置機制與屬性相剋設定，極力鼓勵玩家針對不同敵人靈活更換配裝。

在戰鬥操作上，作者強調不可盲目套用傳統魂系思維，因為敵人的高頻連招極為迅猛。遊戲中持續防禦會消耗殺意值，而殺意值必須依賴切換武器來回復，這要求玩家必須同時熟練掌握兩種武器的輪替節奏。面對高危險技能，作者分享了格鬥遊戲的拆招觀念，建議玩家將視角聚焦於對手動作本體並優化握持手勢以縮短反應時間；在面對強敵時，採取「穩健格擋積攢氣勢、伺機爆發輸出」的穩健打法是相當有效的克敵策略。

在視聽表現方面，作者給予極高評價，特別是遊戲巧妙融合了中式恐怖與傳統武俠風格。諸如頭目青娘阿花登場時的置中對稱構圖，搭配揉合婚慶樂曲、嬰兒啼哭與瘋癲笑聲的配樂，帶來極具壓迫感的沉浸體驗。關卡設計上，本作採用了敵人不重生以及 Boss 第二階段死亡後自動存檔的大膽機制，雖然大幅減少了挫折感，但也意味著無法反覆刷取強化素材；整體主線長度約為 20 至 25 小時。

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM

值得閱讀的理由

  • 開箱評測市面上三款熱門的隨身 AI 設備，直擊宣傳與實際體驗落差巨大的「踩坑」實況。
  • 深入剖析隨身 AI 設備在軟體成熟度、隱私政策、售後客服及硬體品質上的各種真實問題。
  • 反思當我們將日常記憶與情緒解釋權交給 AI 設備時，可能帶來的心理影響與隱憂。

摘要

在這部影片中，創作者實際買了三款宣傳得很吸引人的隨身 AI 設備來進行開箱與深度體驗，總結出「踩坑率高達三分之二」的實際心得。影片透過實測展示了這些產品在行銷與現實之間的落差。

第一款設備：Simpai

這款設備售價較高（影片提及價格區間如 1999 等），但體驗卻狀況百出。購買時發現連店鋪客服都找不到，軟體下載甚至需要透過 TestFlight，App Store 也搜尋不到，隱私政策與軟體許可協議缺乏中文版本，顯然並非針對中國大陸市場正規販售。透過 AI 查詢背景發現其為香港年輕團隊，群眾募資金額不高 [[02:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=135)]。實際使用 App 的時間軸與日記海報功能更像一本「答案之書」，生成的標題與內容十分荒誕、充滿雜音或隨機生成，甚至每張卡片結尾都會固定加上類似的情感對白。設備本身續航力差、夜間待機耗電嚴重、外殼氧化，且相機拍到的東西只轉換成文字不保留圖片，缺乏實質證據 [[04:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=262)]。整體而言找不到優點，售後幾近為零。

第二款設備：Lucky（或類似發音的設備）

這款設備採用黑色樸素機身與磁吸充電器。與前一款不同，它使用起來「稍微有一點 AI 的感覺」 [[05:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=335)]。它會每隔幾分鐘自動錄製短影片或記錄日常，雖然生成的卡通化圖片經常有手指或品種分不清的「幻覺」，但作為日常記憶碎片還算合適。最有趣的是它會主動發出關心或調侃的語音提醒（例如提醒餵貓、關心生物鐘等），甚至能通過觸控板長按進行對話、搜索記憶與識別場景。不過，長期佩戴也帶來了隱私疑慮，且每天生活重複時會顯得有些機械與沉重 [[08:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=523)]。整體而言，這是三款中較有互動感的一款。

第三款設備：類似鵝卵石或吊墜造型的設備（Nana / N 系列）

外觀設計最像飾品，配有精美的小鍊子與鵝卵石充電底座，並藏有光體感應器可隔著衣服測量心跳與呼吸 [[09:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=564)]。其核心能力是記錄心情、說話字數、實時語速及心律，幫助用戶收集快樂的卡片，並會自動記錄用戶去過的地方、看過的電影（例如古希臘神話與奧德修斯） [[10:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=617)]。然而現實體驗同樣骨感，App 經常反覆詢問「有沒有變化」，且宣稱關注隱私的同時卻無法查看錄音原文 [[10:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=657)]，客服回應緩慢。

創作者的深層省思

在花費了四千多元台幣／人民幣體驗這些隨身 AI 設備後，創作者提出了更深層的思考：當我們過度依賴 AI 記錄生活、甚至讓 AI 幫忙定義和解釋我們的情緒與記憶時，是否會不知不覺中把個人記憶與情緒的控制權逐漸移交給了 AI？這值得所有使用者深思。

item.description:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM

值得閱讀的理由

  • 開箱評測市面上三款熱門的隨身 AI 設備，直擊宣傳與實際體驗落差巨大的「踩坑」實況。
  • 深入剖析隨身 AI 設備在軟體成熟度、隱私政策、售後客服及硬體品質上的各種真實問題。
  • 反思當我們將日常記憶與情緒解釋權交給 AI 設備時，可能帶來的心理影響與隱憂。

摘要

在這部影片中，創作者實際買了三款宣傳得很吸引人的隨身 AI 設備來進行開箱與深度體驗，總結出「踩坑率高達三分之二」的實際心得。影片透過實測展示了這些產品在行銷與現實之間的落差。

第一款設備：Simpai

這款設備售價較高（影片提及價格區間如 1999 等），但體驗卻狀況百出。購買時發現連店鋪客服都找不到，軟體下載甚至需要透過 TestFlight，App Store 也搜尋不到，隱私政策與軟體許可協議缺乏中文版本，顯然並非針對中國大陸市場正規販售。透過 AI 查詢背景發現其為香港年輕團隊，群眾募資金額不高 [[02:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=135)]。實際使用 App 的時間軸與日記海報功能更像一本「答案之書」，生成的標題與內容十分荒誕、充滿雜音或隨機生成，甚至每張卡片結尾都會固定加上類似的情感對白。設備本身續航力差、夜間待機耗電嚴重、外殼氧化，且相機拍到的東西只轉換成文字不保留圖片，缺乏實質證據 [[04:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=262)]。整體而言找不到優點，售後幾近為零。

第二款設備：Lucky（或類似發音的設備）

這款設備採用黑色樸素機身與磁吸充電器。與前一款不同，它使用起來「稍微有一點 AI 的感覺」 [[05:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=335)]。它會每隔幾分鐘自動錄製短影片或記錄日常，雖然生成的卡通化圖片經常有手指或品種分不清的「幻覺」，但作為日常記憶碎片還算合適。最有趣的是它會主動發出關心或調侃的語音提醒（例如提醒餵貓、關心生物鐘等），甚至能通過觸控板長按進行對話、搜索記憶與識別場景。不過，長期佩戴也帶來了隱私疑慮，且每天生活重複時會顯得有些機械與沉重 [[08:43](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=523)]。整體而言，這是三款中較有互動感的一款。

第三款設備：類似鵝卵石或吊墜造型的設備（Nana / N 系列）

外觀設計最像飾品，配有精美的小鍊子與鵝卵石充電底座，並藏有光體感應器可隔著衣服測量心跳與呼吸 [[09:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=564)]。其核心能力是記錄心情、說話字數、實時語速及心律，幫助用戶收集快樂的卡片，並會自動記錄用戶去過的地方、看過的電影（例如古希臘神話與奧德修斯） [[10:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=617)]。然而現實體驗同樣骨感，App 經常反覆詢問「有沒有變化」，且宣稱關注隱私的同時卻無法查看錄音原文 [[10:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJrJ96nR-BM&t=657)]，客服回應緩慢。

創作者的深層省思

在花費了四千多元台幣／人民幣體驗這些隨身 AI 設備後，創作者提出了更深層的思考：當我們過度依賴 AI 記錄生活、甚至讓 AI 幫忙定義和解釋我們的情緒與記憶時，是否會不知不覺中把個人記憶與情緒的控制權逐漸移交給了 AI？這值得所有使用者深思。
